weightBasis: Weights are authored design choices grounded in the cited canonical policy positions and stated legal/service stakes. They are not empirical estimates, polling, universal personal preferences or measured organizational endorsements.

interestGroupBoundary.rule: Canonical groups form from actual saved own cost exposures and town/measure keys. This payload does not create groups, memberships, exposures or fixed organization IDs. Nonmoney/supporter group formation is a missing runtime piece, not inferred from these constituency labels.
